description_en: Submit a task to generate a video of a digitized virtual human
description_zh: 提交一个数字人播报视频生成的任务
kebab_example: aliyun avatar submit-avatar-video-task --tenant-id 1 --app AppId=3d95xx946a --title '这是一个示例标题' --video-params 'text_:_测试_,_characterCode_:_CH_xxxxxx' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAvatarVideoTask

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID. Obtain the TenantId from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: App ID. Obtain the corresponding AppId from the Developer Center > Instance Management page. For more information, see [the referenced document]()
fields.help_zh: App ID。在开发者中心-实例管理页面获取对应的appId，参考文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.2527854.0.0.6f124ecfkSTD3w#6a48daa1ee899)
fields.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: App information, representing a business configuration
parameters.help_zh: App信息，代表一个业务配置
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: The title of the submitted video synthesis task
parameters.help_zh: 提交的视频合成的任务标题
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: Related parameters required for the synthesized video
parameters.help_zh: 合成的视频需要的相关参数
parameters.name: video_params

parameters.help_en: Whether this video synthesis task requires an event callback. The default is false, meaning no callback. The platform supports event callbacks at the start and end of a task. For details, see [Digitized Virtual Human Callback Event Notifications]()
parameters.help_zh: 本次视频合成任务是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。平台支持在任务开始和任务结束时进行事件回调，具体可参考文档：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.name: callback

parameters.help_en: Parameters to pass through during the callback, in JSON string format. This parameter does not take effect when Callback is set to false
parameters.help_zh: 回调时需要透传的一些参数，json格式字符串，callback=false时不生效
parameters.name: callback_params

TaskUuid.description_en: Unique task UUID. Use this to query task details later. Make sure to save it
TaskUuid.description_zh: 任务唯一uuid，后续用来查询任务详细请，请务必保存好
